scope: tracked text files of all other sessions on origin/main (COORDINATION.md and this directory excluded)

findings.title: Emigrant-asset route still shown as staged over two years
findings.repo_says: The ladder site labels this route 'up to 2 years of staged remittances' on every cost row and models several wires.
findings.official_says: SAFE Circular Hui Fa [2014] No. 2, section VI(II): the requirement that an immigrant's property be transferred in several instalments 'is cancelled'; after approval the bank 'may remit the relevant funds in a lump sum or in several batches'.
findings.assessment: Superseded rule still published. One remittance is allowed after approval, so the extra wires and the two-year wait are not required.

findings.title: Superseded 2021 HSBC tariff still listed as a verified source
findings.repo_says: The ladder source register keeps 'Account and Service Tariff, Personal Customers (effective 1 January 2021)' as source S06 with status 'verified'.
findings.official_says: HSBC China's tariff in force is the one 'Effective from 31 Oct 2026' (items 2.2.4.1, 2.2.4.2, 2.2.6.1, 2.2.7).
findings.assessment: A superseded price list is still marked verified beside the current one. Prices must be read from the 31 Oct 2026 tariff only.

findings.title: Modelled exchange-rate spread bands presented in cost tables
findings.repo_says: The ladder cost tables price several routes with assumed spread bands such as '0.80% – 3.00%' ('fixed fee not published — spread only').
findings.official_says: Bank of China's own board on 10 Nov 2026 shows USD buying 665.71 and selling 668.51 per USD 100: a gap of 0.42%, i.e. 0.21% from the mid-point to the selling price.
findings.assessment: The bands are assumptions, not published prices, and are several times wider than the one bank margin that could be read from a published board. Treat those tables as scenarios.

findings.title: 7.129 yuan per dollar used as the conversion reference
findings.repo_says: Briefing, repatriate and acceptance pages convert yuan fees to dollars at 7.129, the IRS 2025 yearly average.
findings.official_says: IRS table: 7.129 for 2025 (correctly quoted). Federal Reserve G.5A 2025 average: 7.1875. Bank of China selling rate on 10 Nov 2026: 6.6851.
findings.assessment: Correctly quoted from the IRS, but it is a 2025 average, not a November 2026 price. At the bank's published rate a ¥620 fee is $92.74, not $86.97, and the IRS and Federal Reserve 2025 figures differ by 0.8%.

findings.title: FBAR penalty maxima
findings.repo_says: Briefing, repatriate and acceptance pages state $16,536 (non-willful) and $165,353 (willful floor).
findings.official_says: eCFR 31 CFR 1010.821, current as of 6 Nov 2026: 16,536 and 165,353 for penalties assessed on or after 17 January 2025.
findings.assessment: Matches the official table read today.

findings.title: Form 3520 threshold left 'not verified' by earlier audits
findings.repo_says: Audit audit-ad300459 (flag FL02) and the ladder flags say the Form 3520 threshold was asserted but not verified.
findings.official_says: IRS 'Gifts from foreign person': report when gifts or bequests from a nonresident alien or foreign estate exceed $100,000 in the year; penalty 5% per month up to 25%.
findings.assessment: Now verified against the IRS page: the $100,000 threshold stated elsewhere in the repo is correct.

findings.title: Foreign earned income exclusion amounts
findings.repo_says: Portal and repatriate pages give $130,000 (2025) and $132,900 (2026); an audit note describes $132,900 as the 2025 figure.
findings.official_says: IRS 'Figuring the foreign earned income exclusion': $130,000 for tax year 2025; $132,900 for tax year 2026. The IRS landing page still stops at 2023.
findings.assessment: The amounts are right; the audit note that ties $132,900 to 2025 is mislabelled (it is the 2026 figure).

findings.title: Wise 'send from CNY' described as available with conditions
findings.repo_says: Briefing and repatriate pages list Wise from-CNY: own accounts only, tax records within 3 years, at most ¥300,000 per transfer, fee shown only in the app.
findings.official_says: Wise Help Centre: 'the maximum you can send in one transfer is 300,000 CNY'; a China tax record 'within the last 3 years'; 'only ... to another account you own'.
findings.assessment: Matches the provider's page read today.

findings.title: HSBC Global Transfer 'USD 0–7' wording
findings.repo_says: The root hub and audits record that the former 'USD 0–7' Global Transfer wording is superseded.
findings.official_says: HSBC China tariff effective 31 Oct 2026: Global Transfer to own account is Free (Private Banking, Premier) or USD 20 (Advance); USD 7 is the International Education Payment charge.
findings.assessment: The correction on the hub matches the tariff read today.

findings.title: Willful FBAR penalty formula
findings.repo_says: Briefing pages state the willful penalty as the greater of $165,353 or 50% of the balance.
findings.official_says: 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(C)-(D): the greater of $100,000 (before inflation adjustment) or 50 percent of 'the balance in the account at the time of the violation'.
findings.assessment: Matches the statute and the adjusted figure.

findings.title: Section 988 exchange gains described as ordinary income
findings.repo_says: Several pages say section 988 exchange gains are ordinary; later audits add the personal-transaction exception.
findings.official_says: 26 U.S.C. 988(e): the section does not apply to an individual's personal transaction, and no gain is recognised unless it exceeds $200. Publication 525: above $200 'report it as a capital gain'.
findings.assessment: Both statements are needed together. Whether a savings deposit is a 'personal transaction' is a facts question; this site shows both rate sets.

findings.title: No page priced tax penalties or exchange gain at each $10,000 step
findings.repo_says: Every earlier $10,000-step table prices the transfer (fee, sometimes a spread). None shows U.S. reporting-penalty exposure or the exchange gain by year of acquisition at each step.
findings.official_says: The inputs are published: eCFR penalty table; IRS streamlined terms (0% abroad, 5% in the U.S.); Federal Reserve annual average rates for every year.
findings.assessment: Gap in the earlier work, filled by the Penalty and Exchange-gain pages of this section.

structural: More than a dozen separately built sub-sites on main answer the same question; hub cards quote different counts (15 routes, 17 methods, 22 methods) because each session defined routes differently.
Two root summaries exist side by side: EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md and EXECUTIVE-SUMMARY.md, with different content and dates.
At least ten sessions claimed work between 09:43 and 09:50 UTC on 10 Nov 2026; five of them claimed the root landing page at the same time.
The repository's automated checks test structure, links and arithmetic. None of them re-reads the official pages, so a passing check is not proof that a statement is true.
